# ANN Vector Search Library

> An approximate nearest neighbor vector search library built from scratch in Python, implementing HNSW (Hierarchical Navigable Small World) graphs, with recall and distance-computation cost measured against exact search.

Languages: Python. License: MIT. Source: https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library

## Source

- [src/ann_vector_search_library/__init__.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/__init__.py): ANN Vector Search Library - HNSW approximate nearest neighbor search from scratch.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/brute.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/brute.py): Exact nearest-neighbor search by brute force, for recall ground truth.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/cli.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/cli.py): Command line interface for the HNSW vector search library.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/data.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/data.py): Deterministic synthetic vector datasets with cluster structure.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/distance.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/distance.py): Distance functions over plain Python float vectors.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/evaluation.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/evaluation.py): Evaluation: recall against exact search and the recall/cost trade-off.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/hnsw.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/hnsw.py): Hierarchical Navigable Small World (HNSW) approximate nearest neighbor index.
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/observability.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/observability.py): In-process request metrics for the HTTP service (Prometheus text exposition).
- [src/ann_vector_search_library/service.py](https://github.com/adeoluo/ann-vector-search-library/blob/main/src/ann_vector_search_library/service.py): A standard-library HTTP service exposing the HNSW index.
